notes.title: Patch Update Version 0.6.2
notes.content:
Announcement of patch updates
On  19 July 2023

[list]
[*] Full controller support
[*] Add minigame category to the level selection menu
[*] Add keybind option
[*] Add gamma option
[*] Add look sensitivity setting for controller
[*] Rework option UI
[*] Rework language select UI when launch game for first time
[*] Increase small bell speed 
[*] Feather falling boots can now prevent damage from sharp iron.
[*] The quiz text in stage The Test are use colors that are easier to read
[*] The room that requires a password in the stage Randomness madness will always have compass and a small bell
[/list]

Almost half a year has passed since the last update of the game.
During this time, There have been many things happened.
One of them is announcement of resignation from the party and laying down his political of Prayut Chan-o-cha

Throughout his tenure as Prime Minister of Thailand
He is like a best "gift" the nation receive.
He has done many good things for this country.
He made Thailand move forward up to this point.
Today He is no longer be with us. But Thailand still has to move on.
Even he is not a perfect leader, But at least he has done his best.
And we, the people of Thailand, will definitely never forget him.

I don't personally hate him at all.
Instead, as a Thai citizen I want to thank him.
Without him, Thailand would not be like today.
I would like to thank Uncle Tu from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you very much.

And finally, I would like to thank all of you for following this game all along.

Please let me know if you find more bugs or have any suggestion.
Thanks.

notes.title: Major Patch 0.6
notes.content:
Announcement of major patch updates
On  30 January 2023

[list]
[*] New Stage : Randomness Madness
[*] New Stage : The Test
[*] New Item : Small Bell
[*] New Item and Helper : Cobra Head
[*] New Helper : MONGON
[*] 8 New Achievement
[*] Steam Cloud Support
[*] NVIDIA Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) Support
[*] Add FOV Setting
[*] Add Sound Setting
[*] Add Close Timer Setting
[*] Change  Main Menu Background
[*] Unlock the game ratio
[*] Improve lighting, shadows and textures
[*] improve the door system. it can be push in both directions.
[*] Improve enemy AI
[*] Improve sprinting and stamina system
[*] Improve many stages to make the player experience better.
[*] Improve content in note paper
[*] Globe, It be thrown when used . and there are effects
[*] When the Time is stopped, The time of thrown firecrackers will not decrease.
[*] Add new content in The Secret Room
[*] Add FishStop Sprite sound
[*] FishStop Sprite can disable compass
[*] FishStop Sprite Can obscure the player UI
[*] FishStop Sprite Can no longer attack player in locker
[*] Common FishStop has rename to Normal FishStop 
[*] Normal FishStop is no longer have light
[*] Normal FishStop will have footstep sound if it run
[*] T-Pose FishStop will destroy entire locker (it had been only door before)
[*] FishStop has water footstep if it walk in water
[*] FishStop can no longer see through shelves
[*] Increase FishStop hearing distance
[*] Reduced FishStop heartbeat distance
[*] ESC key can use to exit various UIs
[*] F1 key can use to hide player UI 
[*] Right shift key can use to sprint
[*] Q key can use item
[*] Added 2 new messages to the loading page
[*] You can click to change the text on the loading page
[*] Leaderboard page change button is moved to the top.
[*] You can look for own position on leaderboard
[*] Voice and game language can be selected separately when entering the game for the first time.
[*] Increase archive background opacity
[*]Add be quit confirmation window in pause menu
[*] Change guide text on in helper page to "Some helper can only be used in Challenge stages."
[*] If you facing back will be able to interact with what is behind
[*] Player will always face straight when hiding in the locker.
[*] in the challenge stage rice sack will respawn when player collects all the rice sack.
[*] When wearing boots, You will not get hurt by sharp iron.
[*] Increases the brightness of glowing stone
[*] Reduce the brightness of Kagura Bell of chaos.
[*] Kagura Bell of chaos can summon small bell
[*] Firecrackers has a light
[*] Teleporter will not take player to a room that's too close.
[*] Bug Fixed : Pressing F to turn off the flashlight will cause the item selector to disappear.
[*] Bug Fixed : FishStop still chase player after revive or teleport.
[/list]

Please let me know if you find more bugs or have any suggestion.
Thanks you very much.

notes.title: Happy Songkran Day and Announce for big update
notes.content:
Happy Songkran Day!

Songkran Day is Thai New Year and a public holiday.
It will take place in the period of 13 to 15 April of every year.
Wish everyone Very happy today.

I have to thank everyone. That pay attention And supported our game for almost a month and a half.
I promise I won't give you up. I won't let you down. I won't run around and desert you.
And on this Songkran Day I will announce for a big patch update. To version 0.4
This update will be "FREE" and will be available on April 18, 2021 to anyone who purchases this game.
And for those of you who haven't owned this game yet, don't worry. I have no plans to raise the price of the game.
Have fun. Please let me know if you find more bugs or have any suggestion.

Thanks.
